messages:
clare_ops: Heads-up — EU staging canary for payments-v3 scheduled 2026-06-03 15:00 UTC. Deploy-bot will run helm upgrade with chart payments/3.4.2. Key values change: rateLimiter.enabled=true and rateLimiter.bucket_size=500. Rollout SLO: 10m. Need release notes blurb + rollback criteria. @release-czar can you coordinate? :calendar:

alice.nguyen: Are we pinning the image digest? I vote yes for canary.

ben.kim: Deploy-bot preflight shows migration flag defaulting to async=false — daniel, is that intended? If migration runs sync it could cause downtime.

daniel.s: Not intended. The chart change sets `migrations.runSync` -> false in values but CI updated default to true accidentally. Set `migrations.runSync=false` in the overlay for canary.

clare_ops: Good catch. We'll add an overlay and pin image. Also: postupgrade hook has flaked before on < 30s network blips — add hook timeout bump to 5m.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by @clare_ops at 2026-06-03T15:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: running preflight checks... config-schema ok, image-digest pinned, helm lint ok, resources within quotas.

ben.kim: Proposed rollback criteria (canary):
- 5% 5xx rate sustained > 2m
- p99 latency above 800ms for 3 consecutive windows
- downstream payment-provider errors increase by >3x
- failed postupgrade hook
If any trigger -> automatic pause + manual rollback decision.

alice.nguyen: Add resource OOM kill threshold: any pod OOMKilled during canary -> pause.

release-czar: Agreed. We'll also keep a manual escape hatch: `kubectl rollout undo` allowed by infra on-call for 30m window. I will draft release notes: short blurb about rate limiter toggle, pinning digest, and migration flag fix.

clare_ops: Helm command for runbook:
```bash
helm upgrade --install payments v3/payments --namespace staging \
  --values overlays/staging-rate-limiter.yaml \
  --set image.tag=sha256:abcdef1234567890 \
  --wait --timeout 10m
```

clare_ops: I'll attach the overlay snippet to the release note draft.

ben.kim: Also add a canary traffic split: 10% traffic for 10m -> 25% for next 20m, then 100% if stable.

deploy-bot: canary traffic policy applied: 10% -> 25% -> 100% with windows 10m/20m.

alice.nguyen: Small note for QA: check rate-limit headers `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and watch for 429 spikes.

daniel.s: I'll run a quick DB migration dry-run in staging now and post results.

daniel.s: dry-run OK, no schema drift reported. Migration plan set to `runSync=false` in overlay.

clare_ops: OK team — release notes draft: "payments-v3: enable rate limiter (opt-in) behind flag; migration flag corrected to async mode; image pinned to sha256:...; increased hook timeout." I'll post for review in #release-notes. :memo:

release-czar: LGTM. I'll publish the release note and keep watch during canary. :eyes:

clare_ops: If we hit any rollback criteria deploy-bot will pause rollout and tag thread. If manual rollback happens, we pin back to payments chart 3.4.1 and image sha256:12345abc.

ben.kim: ack. I'll be on-call at 15:00 UTC for the window.

alice.nguyen: Thanks — will monitor logs and dashboards.

deploy-bot: canary completed first window: 10% stable. continuing to next window.

deploy-bot: second window ended. metrics stable. continuing to 100%.

deploy-bot: rollout successful. marking thread resolved. :tada:
